title: Haskell Boat Company Collection: archival finding aid
authors: The Henry Ford, Benson Ford Research Center
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: The Henry Ford finding aid identifies Haskell Boat Company, a subsidiary of Haskell Manufacturing Company, as a Ludington producer of moulded plywood canoes in 1917–1934. Its unprocessed archival collection may have restricted access; the finding aid is publicly readable.
